meta_description:
1,169 likes, 120 comments - bhiveworkspace on September 8, 2026: "A fitness icon. A workspace brand. One very different idea of work. 

BHIVE is now the First Campus Workspace Company to Launch a Brand Film and we’re proud to bring it to life with Milind Soman. 🎬 

This isn’t just a film about offices. 

It’s about what a workday can feel like when fitness, movement, community, play and recharge are all part of the experience. 

Because at BHIVE, work doesn’t have to mean sitting still. 

Play. Focus. Recharge. The BHIVE Way. 

Watch the film and tell us your favourite moment. ✨

#BHIVEMovesWithMilind 

#BHIVE #MilindSoman #WorkLifeHarmony #FutureOfWork #Coworking #FitnessFirst #WorkspaceReimagined #PlayFocusRecharge".
